shortDescription: Configure Infoblox NIOS DTC HTTP monitors

options.name: ciphers
options.description: Configures an optional cipher list for the secure HTTP/S connection.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: Configures an optional client certificate, supplied in a secure HTTP/S mode if present.

options.name: comment
options.description: Configures a text string comment to be associated with the instance of this object.  The provided text string will be configured on the object instance.

options.name: content_check
options.description: Configures the content check type

options.name: content_check_input
options.description: Configures the portion of the response to use as input for content check.

options.name: content_check_op
options.description: Configures the content check success criteria operator.

options.name: content_check_regex
options.description: Configures the content check regular expression. Values with leading or trailing white space are not valid for this field.

options.name: content_extract_group
options.description: Configures the content extraction sub-expression to extract.

options.name: content_extract_type
options.description: Configures the content extraction expected type for the extracted data.

options.name: content_extract_value
options.description: Configures the content extraction value to compare with the extracted result. Values with leading or trailing white space are not valid for this field.

options.name: enable_sni
options.description: Configures whether or not Server Name Indication (SNI) for the HTTPS monitor is enabled.

options.name: extattrs
options.description: Allows for the configuration of Extensible Attributes on the instance of the object.  This argument accepts a set of key / value pairs for configuration.

options.name: interval
options.description: Configures the interval for HTTP health check.

options.name: name
options.description: Configures the display name for this DTC monitor. Values with leading or trailing white space are not valid for this field.

options.name: port
options.description: Configures the port value for HTTP requests.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: request
options.description: Configures the HTTP request to send

options.name: result
options.description: Configures the type of the expected result

options.name: result_code
options.description: Configures the expected return code

options.name: retry_down
options.description: Configures the value of how many times the server should appear as down to be treated as dead after it was alive.

options.name: retry_up
options.description: Configures the value of how many times the server should appear as up to be treated as alive after it was dead.

options.name: secure
options.description: Configures the security status of the connection.

options.name: state
options.description: Configures the intended state of the instance of the object on the NIOS server.  When this value is set to C(present), the object is configured on the device and when this value is set to C(absent) the value is removed (if necessary) from the device.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Configures the timeout for HTTP health check in seconds.

options.name: validate_cert
options.description: Configures whether the validation of the remote server's certificate is enabled.
